answer.explanation: Commit 24f3656 (22:43 UTC) changed template.yaml so CrudApiFunction's TABLE_NAME went from !Ref CartTable to the literal 'missing-table'. The live configuration was updated at 22:45:15 UTC and now has TABLE_NAME=missing-table, matching the template. From 22:45:32 onward, every CrudApi invocation fails with AccessDeniedException on dynamodb:PutItem against table/missing-table. The CrudApiRole grants PutItem/GetItem/Query only on CartTable, so the role is correct and the IAM layer is not the cause. The error traces point to the bad environment variable, which the IaC change introduced.
